SK hynix 2026 Q2 Preview (Historical Reconstruction)

Status: This document is a retrospective reconstruction. It uses only information published on or before 23 April 2026 23:59:59. It was not actually written before the Q2 2026 earnings release.

Conclusion: SK hynix announced record Q1 2026 results on 23 April 2026. The core question for Q2 2026 is whether revenue can grow from this high base. The company says that DRAM and NAND pricing conditions will remain favorable. The company says that customer demand exceeds supply capacity. AI infrastructure investment continues to drive demand. This preview therefore expects Q2 revenue to grow sequentially. The operating margin may stay high. However, the 72% operating margin is far above the historical range. Product mix normalization and higher depreciation may reduce the margin.

Baseline (Q1 2026, K-IFRS, consolidated): Revenue was 52.5763 trillion KRW. This was up 60% from Q4 2025. Q4 2025 revenue was 32.8267 trillion KRW. Operating profit was 37.6103 trillion KRW. This was up 96% from Q4 2025. Operating margin was 72%. Net profit was 40.3459 trillion KRW. Net margin was 77%. Net profit was higher than operating profit. Therefore net profit included non-operating income. Cash was 54.3 trillion KRW. Interest-bearing debt was 19.3 trillion KRW. Net cash was 35 trillion KRW. The Q1 figures are preliminary and subject to audit.

Core questions for Q2 2026:
1. Can revenue grow sequentially? Q1 was a seasonal low quarter, but demand was strong. Q2 has lighter seasonal pressure. AI order continuity is the key variable.
2. Can the 72% operating margin continue? High-value products support the mix. The company says that this year's investment will increase significantly. Rising depreciation will pressure the margin.
3. Do new products and capacity ramp on schedule? LPDDR6 (1cnm) and 192GB SOCAMM2 started mass production in April. The 321-layer QLC PQC21 and Solidigm synergy support storage. Watch M15X ramp, Yongin cluster preparation, and EUV equipment progress.

Expectation gaps:
Positive: The company guides favorable pricing for DRAM and NAND. Net cash of 35 trillion KRW supports expansion. LPDDR6 and SOCAMM2 are industry-leading products. Solidigm strengthens high-capacity QLC eSSD.
Negative: The 72% operating margin and the 77% net margin are at extreme levels. Mix or depreciation changes may cause a sequential decline. The net profit included non-operating income. Its sustainability is uncertain. The Q1 figures are preliminary. Higher investment will increase future depreciation.

Verification points in the Q2 2026 release:
1. Revenue: check sequential growth and a level above 52.58 trillion KRW.
2. Operating profit: check a level at or above 37.6 trillion KRW and margin at or above 72%.
3. Net profit: check a level at or above 40.35 trillion KRW. Check whether non-operating income shrank.
4. Cash: check whether net cash expanded.
5. Guidance: check comments on DRAM and NAND prices, HBM supply, and agentic AI inference demand.
6. Investment and products: check M15X, Yongin, and EUV progress. Check LPDDR6, SOCAMM2, and PQC21 shipment pace.

Source: https://news.skhynix.com/en/q1-2026-business-results/
reader_questions: 1Q26 净利润（40.35 万亿韩元）高于营业利润（37.61 万亿韩元），若差额主要来自一次性/营业外收益，2Q26 的盈利环比比较是否应改用营业利润口径，以免高估常态盈利能力？
公司指引“价格条件有利”是否等于 DRAM/NAND 价格继续上涨？若仅为供需偏紧下的价格持稳或跌幅收窄，2Q26 利润率就不能以 1Q26 为锚线性外推。
公司称今年投资规模将“大幅增加”——若 M15X、龙仁、EUV 等资本开支在 2026 年内转固并计提折旧，72% 的营业利润率在下半年是否必然回落？这会否改变市场对全年利润率的预期路径？
fact_checks:
第一轮（逐项对照原始来源）：
1. 日期/季度：来源为 2026-04-23 发布的 1Q26（FY2026 Q1）业绩；target_event_date 2026-07-29 为 2Q26 计划财报日，本稿未引用该日之后信息。
2. 币种/单位：均为韩元（KRW）；来源表格单位为 Billion KRW（52,576.3 = 52.5763 万亿韩元），正文换算口径正确；环比百分比与表格一致（收入 +60%、营业利润 +96%、净利润 +165%；营业利润率 72%、净利润率 77%）。
3. 会计口径：K-IFRS 合并报表，与公告一致。
4. 集团/分部：来源仅披露集团合并数，无 DRAM/NAND/HBM 分项；本稿未编造分项数据。
5. 事实/指引/推论区分：收入、利润、现金、负债、产品计划为公告事实；“价格环境有利”“投资规模大幅增加”为公司指引；“2Q26 有望环比增长”“72% 利润率有回落风险”为本稿推论，正文已作推断表述。
6. 特殊核对：净利润（40.3459 万亿）> 营业利润（37.6103 万亿），可推知含营业外净收益，正文已注明环比比较口径。
7. 局限：1Q26 为初步数据，尚待独立审计；来源未提供现金流量表、分产品毛利率或市场共识。
8. 未使用来源外信息：无股价、无共识数字、无 2Q26 实际结果。

第二轮（怀疑的初次阅读者）：
1) 问：净利润高于营业利润约 2.7 万亿韩元，2Q 环比比较会不会失真？→ 正文在上季基准注明“含营业外净收益，环比比较需注意口径”，验证点第 3 条加入“营业外损益贡献是否收窄”。
2) 问：“价格环境有利”是涨价还是仅供需偏紧？→ 正文沿用公司原话“价格环境将持续有利”，未引申为涨价幅度或毛利率方向。
3) 问：现金增加 19.4 万亿韩元来自经营还是融资？→ 来源未披露现金流细节，正文只引用期末余额，未推断资金来源；投资“大幅增加”的折旧影响列入负预期差。
